definitions.explanation: Guidance or recommendations offered to someone.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}から{助言|じょげん}を{もらう|もらう}。
examples.english: To receive advice from a teacher.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}に{助言|じょげん}を{求|もと}める。
examples.english: To seek advice from an expert.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な{助言|じょげん}をする。

notes:
{助言|じょげん} means advice or counsel.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {助言|じょげん}を{求|もと}める: to seek advice
- {助言|じょげん}を{与|あた}える: to give advice
- {助言|じょげん}に{従|したが}う: to follow advice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アドバイス: advice (casual)
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}: warning, admonition
- {勧告|かんこく}: recommendation (formal)
